entities.summary:
Parson's Curse (1891) short story by sir arthur conan doyle

A Scandal in Bohemia is a pivotal narrative in the Sherlock Holmes canon, featuring the iconic detective's first encounter with Irene Adler.

The tale of the 'Woman' who outwitted Holmes has captivated audiences for generations, solidifying her place as one of literature's most enduring female characters.

Doyle's masterful storytelling weaves a complex web of intrigue and deception, showcasing Holmes's intellectual prowess while also subverting his expectations of superiority.

A Scandal in Bohemia has had lasting repercussions on popular culture, influencing numerous adaptations, parodies, and references across various media platforms.
